@mapAggregateLoadedRecords.description: Count of actual records represented by this supplied aggregate, not unique people or the entire source population.

@mapAggregateBadgeRecords.description: Unit shown below a cluster bitmap's actual loaded member-record count.

mapAggregateLoadedOnly: Loaded scope only (*) — the complete matching population may be larger

@mapAggregateLoadedOnly.description: Explains the asterisk on incomplete or unknown-total cluster symbols without inventing a full total.

@mapAggregateMetric.description: Producer-defined aggregate measure, value and unit, distinct from its loaded member-record count.

@mapAggregateMetricUnknown.description: Unknown aggregate metric remains unknown rather than zero; preserves the supplied measure and unit.

mapAggregateScopeExplanation: This group represents the supplied records in this map result. Its count is not a city-wide total or a count of unique people.

@mapAggregateScopeExplanation.description: Explains the scope and count semantics of an aggregate independently of colour or map zoom.

mapAggregateGroupTotal: Exact matching records in this group: {count}

@mapAggregateGroupTotal.description: An explicit exact group/member-query total from the server, never derived from a partial list or inferred as a viewport-wide total.

mapAggregateSameLocation: Several records share this location. Open a member below to view its own details.

@mapAggregateSameLocation.description: Explains why an exact colocated MultiPoint can remain grouped even at a close zoom.

@mapAggregateZoom.description: Accessible action forwarding the group's supplied navigation bounds without inventing a geometry extent.

@mapAggregateMembersTitle.description: Heading for the bounded, snapshot-bound member records list.

@mapAggregateMembersLoaded.description: Number of unique member records currently retrieved by the client; this is never substituted for the full-query total.

@mapAggregateMemberUnit.description: Preserves the member-page producer's supplied unit, separately from the client record count.

@mapAggregateMembersLoading.description: Readable and accessible progress label for a bounded member-page request.

mapAggregateSnapshotExpired: This group snapshot has expired. Refresh the map and select the group again.

@mapAggregateSnapshotExpired.description: An expired group cannot be resumed using stale cursors; a new viewport snapshot is required.

@mapAggregateRefreshSnapshot.description: Action requesting a new viewport snapshot after the member snapshot expires.

@mapAggregateMembersRetry.description: Manual action for retryable member requests; retained members keep their original source time.

mapAggregateMembersEmpty: No member records were returned for this group.

@mapAggregateMembersEmpty.description: Describes an empty successful member page without asserting a measured zero or verified source-wide no-match coverage.

mapAggregateMembersBounded: This list has reached its display limit. More records may exist; zoom to the group for a narrower view.

@mapAggregateMembersBounded.description: The client stops after its bounded row/page limit while preserving unknown or partial totals.

@mapAggregateMembersMore.description: Keyboard-accessible manual action fetching the next bounded snapshot-bound member page.
